_comment: Channel configuration. source_url = single IPTV stream URL; source_urls = ordered list of primary + backup URLs tried on failover. Set enabled=false to skip. PROVIDER NOTE (tvon247.com): Xtream panel that (a) FILTERS user-agents — only an app/browser UA passes, the IPTV Smarters UA in run_channel.sh works; (b) serves live via a no-extension URL that 302-redirects to a tokenized segment host; ffmpeg follows it automatically. Account ACCT1, 5 max connections.

iptv._comment: Credentials moved to untracked config/accounts.env (see @@ACCTn@@ placeholders in source_urls). This block is not read by any script.

channels._comment_source: tvon247 id 1027109 = DAZN MUNDIAL HD (the live World Cup / Mundial feed; H264 1080p25, MP2 stereo). No channel is literally named 'FIFA World Cup 2026' on this provider — DAZN Mundial is the live match carrier for the MX/LatAm package.
channels._comment_audio: audio_sync=preserve (2026-06-25): the default regen (asetpts=N/SR/TB) raced channel1's audio PTS ~70,000s ahead of video -> browser couldn't align -> infinite-load / lag. All 3 failover feeds are A/V-aligned at source (gap 0.02-0.39s, mp2 or AAC-LC), so preserve (asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS) keeps them aligned. Same fix as channel2.
channels._comment_video: encode @ 540p, CRF24 (sharper than the old crf28). 720p was tried 2026-06-24 but 720p re-encode on 2 vCPU overran the box (load 3.2+); 540p is this box's re-encode ceiling. Native HD needs either a bigger server or the copy-standby fix. Copy was reverted (bufferAppendError at live<->standby codec boundary).
channels._comment_failover: Backups are the same World Cup match on DAZN MUNDIAL FHD/HD2 — a dropped primary fails over instantly instead of going to a standby gap.

channels._comment_source: tvon247 id 1349033 = (ES) VIX - CANAL 5, H264 720p30 + AAC stereo. Switched from 1028333 (MX CANAL 5 HD) on 2026-06-24: that feed stalled-then-raced and flipped HEVC<->H264 (delivered 0s in a 25s raw test). VIX delivers steadily AND is consistent H264 (cheaper decode than the HEVC feed). Other Canal 5 ids on this provider were down at switch time: 30634 LATINO, 214633 HOND (0s); 273253 UY raced (2x).
channels._comment_audio: REAL AUDIO via audio_sync=preserve (2026-06-24). VIX Canal 5's A/V is aligned AT THE SOURCE (gap ~0.06s) but it OVER-DELIVERS audio; the default asetpts=N/SR/TB regen rebuilt PTS from the inflated sample count and raced the audio ~26h ahead of video (browser wouldn't start). 'preserve' keeps the source's aligned PTS (asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS) instead. If audio ever desyncs again, set force_silent_audio=true to fall back to silent.
channels._comment_video: encode @ 540p, CRF24 (720p overran 2 vCPU; 540p is the ceiling).
